items.reasons: This is a flat front view of a narrow, tall soda tower. Its top shows only a 1–2 row grey strip with no lit counter plane, and the dispenser nozzles and cup slots are a noisy grey comb. At only about 1 tile wide with a thin cabinet, it is too small and spindly next to the originals' 2-tile counters, and the rainbow block of syrup colours reads as a sticker.

The case is a straight front view. The top is just a thin grey band under a red header, with no 3+ row top plane, and the shelf planks are single bright lines seen edge-on instead of planes seen from above. The bottles are 1px-wide bright spikes with random white highlights that look noisy next to the original cooler's even bottle rows.

The gondola is drawn as a front-on box. The shelves are edge-on white bars with no top surfaces, and the top band reads as a frame, not a lit shelf plane. The snack packs are muddy orange/yellow blobs with sticker-yellow highlights, and the packs at the right end of each shelf run into the side post and look cut off.
